title: London Bridge Is Falling Down
description: The English nursery rhyme everyone can hum, in C major: a stepwise tune that sits in one five-finger position with a single thumb shift at the end. A first piece for playing hands together with a steady left-hand accompaniment.

arrangements.label: Beginner
arrangements.notes: The whole tune once through in C major with the right hand in D position (thumb on D) and the left hand playing only two fifths, C-G and B-G, as half and whole notes.
teachingPoints: Right hand sits with the thumb on D (D-E-F-G-A under fingers 1-5); the only shift is the final la-dy, where finger 2 plays E and the thumb slides down to C.
Bars 1 and 5 open with a dotted quarter plus eighth (Lon-don): count 1-2-and so the A lands on the and of beat 2.
Left hand holds a C-G fifth (fingers 5-1) and moves finger 5 down to B for the G-chord bars 3 and 7; practise the B-G change alone until it is silent.
Play hands separately first, then together at a slow tempo; the left hand changes only on beats 1 and 3.
